name: ChartRecordManager
title: Chart record manager
description: Full CRUD over a writable chart collection: record list with per-row edit/delete, template-prefilled create buttons, and a data-entry modal that fires the collection's MOIS mutation (create 0 / update id / delete negative id). Composes ChartRecordTable and the SubformScoring modal; modeled on the vendor's Bright Health CRUD test forms.
author: Northern Health
